Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and a pair of flanges extending from the web, and the third member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, and each of the members includes at least one layer of reinforcing fibers.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes three patches on each of the members.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and the layer of adhesive extends beyond the void into interfacial layers between the composite members.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape with a web and a pair of flanges on each end of the web, the structure including radius areas between the web and the flanges and a cap being joined to the first set of flanges while the base is joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and adhesive joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone.
